change.description: Preserve the GitHub reader comment boundary for public Memo reads and writes when an administrator changes publication state concurrently, while keeping the existing target-aware comment surface and private Memo behavior.
change.release_unit_description: static frontend and full-feature Docker image

planned.reasoning: This is a backward-compatible consistency repair for the public comment boundary. It does not change response shapes, authentication roles, moderation semantics, persistent schemas, or private AI access.

evidence.command: Locked public target visibility and reader comment lifecycle requirements

current.reasoning: The candidate retains target-aware REST/tRPC behavior and all existing comment lifecycle contracts, while public reads, deletes, counts, and creates bind publication state to their database operation and clipping reads to a synchronized canonical-file visibility check. All administrator canonical Memo writers, including the Memo router, MCP tools, and local Markdown file manager, share the same visibility lock; MCP list selection and projection use that lock as one operation, public Memo fields and metadata are allowlisted fail-closed with publishable attachments rewritten through the public-media boundary, and MCP/router creation uses exclusive file creation to reject path collisions. Memo create, update, and delete failures restore canonical files and indexed rows before returning. The change remains within the existing comment and Memo detail surfaces.
